title: Márai Sándor's Diary: Judging Conduct
goal: I can grade a person's conduct with a degree adverb (*szakmailag feddhetetlenül*, *erkölcsileg mélységesen aggályos*).
I can say what the text about Márai Sándor tells about him and his diary.
I can name the dangers of conformism (*szellemi konformizmus*, *öncenzúra*, *nyelvrontás*).
